_help.what: Actual completion time per milestone, when the plan's Status cell does not carry one. Each 'actual' is a judgment call: the milestone's own gate or deliverable passing (gate green, blind review returned, completion report written), cross-validated against LOG.md. Entries here override the Status cell.
_help.launch: Optional: the run's first model call as ISO-8601 UTC; only needed when no --timeline is given.
_help.note: Record the evidence for the timestamp (the LOG.md entry, commit, or harness event) so the judgment is auditable. The builder ignores it.
_help.label: Optional: a shorter row label than the plan's milestone text.
